description: This file defines the VideoPlayerProvider class, which manages state and controls for video playback within a Flutter application. It handles video initialization, playback control, mute toggling, and UI state (expanded or mini player).

classes.name: VideoPlayerProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the state of video playback, including controller lifecycle, current video, playback controls, and UI state (full/mini player).

methods.name: _disposeController
methods.description: Safely disposes of the current VideoPlayerController, pausing, removing listeners, and disposing of resources.

methods.name: _buildController
methods.description: Creates a VideoPlayerController for a given VideoItem, choosing between network or asset source with fallback handling.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Begins playback of a given VideoItem, initializing the controller, managing mute and expand state, and handling errors.

methods.name: _onControllerUpdate
methods.description: Listener callback for controller updates, propagating error states and refreshing UI.

methods.name: togglePlay
methods.description: Toggles between play and pause states.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks the video to a specified position.

methods.name: toggleMute
methods.description: Toggles the mute state and updates the controller volume.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Sets the UI state to expanded or mini player.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback, clears current video, and hides the player.
